The '''YV-26 Starforged blaster rifle''' was a model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It was a similar model to the [[YV-24 Starforged blaster rifle]], but featured an extension on its barrel.

The weapon would see widespread use among soldiers and technicians in the [[Eternal Alliance]].

==Behind the scenes==
The YV-26 Starforged blaster rifle was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Master's Shadow Pack.
